The biggest WWE Premium Live Event of the summer is here, and[SiriusXM’s new WWE Radio](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/wwe-radio) is bringing every moment to listeners nationwide.


Ahead of both nights of WWE SummerSlam, WWE Radio (Ch. 156) is broadcasting live from Minneapolis with exclusive coverage, WWE Superstar interviews, expert analysis, and live play-by-play from inside the arena.


[WWE Radio (Ch. 156) Live WWE matches, exclusive shows & superstar interviews Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSummerSlamWWERadio)


### Hear WWE SummerSlam live on WWE Radio


WWE Radio’s first live event broadcast begins with SummerSlam on Saturday, August 1 and Sunday, August 2 as lead play-by-play announcer Vic Joseph teams up with WWE Hall of Famer Booker T to call every match and every unforgettable moment live from Minneapolis.


Tune in live to WWE SummerSlam, plus pre- and post-event coverage, on satellite channel 156 on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSummerSlamWWERadio) .


The channel is also the home for live audio coverage of WWE’s other Premium Live Events throughout the year, including:


- WrestleMania
- Royal Rumble
- Survivor Series


### WWE Radio broadcasts live from Minneapolis


Leading up to SummerSlam, WWE Radio will broadcast several live shows from the Minneapolis Convention Center, giving fans behind-the-scenes access throughout the weekend.


Dave LaGreca, Bully Ray, Mark Henry, Tommy Dreamer, Sam Roberts, and Peter Rosenberg will host live from Minneapolis, breaking down storylines, interviewing WWE Superstars and personalities, and taking fans inside one of WWE’s biggest weekends of the year.


Listen to Busted Open on the SiriusXM app or wherever you get your podcasts.


[Busted Open The best pro wrestling show Listen Now Listen Now](https://link.podtrac.com/bustedopen)


### SummerSlam Saturday match card


Saturday’s action features several blockbuster matchups, including:


- Undisputed WWE Championship: CM Punk (c) vs. Cody Rhodes
- Hell in a Cell: Oba Femi vs. Brock Lesnar
- Women’s World Championship: Liv Morgan (c) vs. IYO SKY
- Gunther vs. Nick Aldis
- Six-Man Tag Team Match: LA Knight, Solo Sikoa & Royce Keys vs. Jacob Fatu & The Usos
- Six-Women Tag Team Match: The Bella Twins & Paige vs. Fatal Influence


### SummerSlam Sunday match card


The excitement continues Sunday with another stacked lineup:


- World Heavyweight Championship: Roman Reigns (c) vs. Seth Rollins
- Interim WWE Women’s Championship Ladder Match: Tiffany Stratton vs. Jade Cargill vs. Charlotte Flair vs. Chelsea Green vs. ???
- Intercontinental Championship: Penta (c) vs. Chad Gable
- United States Championship: Trick Williams (c) vs. Baron Corbin
- Undisputed WWE Championship No. 1 Contender’s Match: Sami Zayn vs. Finn Bálor
- Danhausen vs. Dominik Mysterio


### About WWE Radio


Launched on July 27, WWE Radio is SiriusXM’s dedicated home for year-round WWE coverage. The channel features exclusive talk shows, interviews, analysis, and live play-by-play of WWE’s biggest Premium Live Events, including WrestleMania, SummerSlam, Royal Rumble, and Survivor Series.
